title: Job Opportunities API input
description: Pick a mode, add filters, set a result cap. You pay per record returned — never for empty pages or for filters that match nothing.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch. Jobs = live vacancies. Closed jobs = roles that left their source (hiring signal). Companies = employers with open roles.
enumTitles: Closed jobs — roles that came off their source

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on records returned (and billed). The run stops as soon as it is reached. Use Start cursor to continue a large pull in a later run.

query.title: Search text
query.description: Full-text over job title, company name and location (Jobs / Closed jobs), or over the company name (Companies). Example: data engineer berlin

titleQuery.title: Title contains
titleQuery.description: Full-text over the job title only. ANDs with everything else. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

titleExclude.title: Title excludes
titleExclude.description: Drop rows whose title matches these words, e.g. intern trainee. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

descriptionContains.title: Description contains
descriptionContains.description: Full-text over the advert body (only rows that carry a description). Example: kubernetes terraform. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes, e.g. DE, GR, FR, NL. Empty = worldwide.

city.title: City
city.description: City name as it appears in the ledger, e.g. Berlin. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

remote.title: Work model
remote.description: Remote / hybrid / on-site. Note: for most rows the work model is INFERRED — tick 'Only source-confirmed remote status' to keep rows where the employer stated it.

remoteConfirmed.title: Only source-confirmed remote status
remoteConfirmed.description: Keep only rows whose remote status was published by the employer (not inferred by us).

employmentTypes.title: Employment type
employmentTypes.description: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Temporary, Internship, or not_stated.

seniorities.title: Seniority
seniorities.description: Entry, Intern, Mid, Senior, Lead, Manager, Director, Executive, or not_stated. Seniority is inferred and only stated where confidence is high.

categories.title: Job category
categories.description: Job family. 'uncategorised' selects rows without a confident classification.

sourceTypes.title: Source type
sourceTypes.description: Where the row comes from: Employer ATS, company career site, or public employment agency.

companySlugs.title: Company slugs
companySlugs.description: Restrict to specific employers by JOA slug (find slugs in Companies mode), e.g. e-vita-gmbh.

companyDomains.title: Company domains
companyDomains.description: Restrict to employers by bare domain (no scheme, no path), e.g. stripe.com, figma.com.

hasSalary.title: Only rows with a published salary
hasSalary.description: Keep only rows whose salary was published by the employer. Roughly 2% of the ledger carries structured salary — combine with a country to keep results useful.

minSalaryEurAnnual.title: Minimum annual salary (EUR)
minSalaryEurAnnual.description: Lower bound on the normalised annual salary in EUR. Implies published salary.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted in the last N days. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

verifiedWithinDays.title: Re-verified within (days)
verifiedWithinDays.description: Only roles re-confirmed at their source in the last N days — the freshness filter. Most of the ledger is re-checked within 48 hours, so 2 is a good value. Jobs / Closed jobs only.

closedWithinDays.title: Closed within (days)
closedWithinDays.description: Closed jobs mode: only roles that closed in the last N days.

closedReason.title: Closed reason
closedReason.description: Closed jobs mode: why the role left the ledger.

includeDescription.title: Include full advert text
includeDescription.description: Add the full job description (about 2.5 KB per row) in a description field. Same price per record.

companyOrgType.title: Employer type
companyOrgType.description: Companies mode only: organisation type filter, e.g. BPO, Staffing, Enterprise (see the values in Companies-mode output).

companyHasWebsite.title: Only employers with a verified website

startCursor.title: Start cursor
startCursor.description: Resume a previous pull: paste the next_cursor from that run's SUMMARY record. Keep every other input identical.
